reason: the sre lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: sre lens, medium: If jq fails while updating `blob` with the skipped cycle member's verdict/status during DSCMBR-1, the error is silenced by `2>/dev/null` and the `&&` short-circuit leaves blob unchanged, so exit_when/abort_when/until predicates that reference that member see it as absent (not complete), potentially causing incorrect cycle-exit decisions with no log or event to explain why. (core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh:1477; fix: code)

sre lens, medium: When `_cycle_state_write_iter_start` fails, only a warn is printed to stderr; no event is emitted, so the failure has no machine-readable trace; a resume after a mid-iteration interruption following this failure would silently restart from iter 1 instead of the interrupted iteration, defeating requirement R2 with no observable signal other than a lost stderr line. (core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh:2479; fix: code)
